filter_note.note: Hand pass kept 67 club-room items (dropped MLB/NBA/NHL/F1/college bleed, Swiftie/celebrity, power-rank filler, wrong-club parks, nostalgia, near-dups). Quiet is correct for ARI, TB.

items.title: Falcons QB Drama Lingers with Rush Eyed for Week 2 Start
items.one_line: After a shaky Week 1 debut where Rush threw for 143 yards, a touchdown, and two picks, the Falcons appear set to give him another shot while checking Tagovailoa's oblique and Penix's ACL recovery.

items.title: Falcons Eye Penix as Starter Once He's Ready After Rough Week 1
items.one_line: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports the team wants Penix to start when he's fully ready—he's cleared to practice but says he isn't there yet ahead of Week 2 vs. Carolina.

items.title: Falcons Fans Call for Rookie QB Jack Strand After Rush Struggles
items.one_line: In a 20-13 loss to Pittsburgh, Cooper Rush went 12 of 22 for 143 yards with two picks; fans are pushing for undrafted rookie Jack Strand as Atlanta preps for Carolina.

items.title: Ravens Sign WR Gage Larvadain to Practice Squad, Release Kicker Jake Moody
items.one_line: Baltimore signed undrafted Gage Larvadain and released Jake Moody, addressing injuries to Zay Flowers and Ja'Kobi Lane after the 41-23 win over the Colts.

items.title: Ravens Rookie Ja'Kobi Lane Faces Wrist Surgery, Eyes One-Month Return
items.one_line: The third-round pick from USC will undergo wrist surgery with doctors targeting a return in about a month after exiting the Week 1 win over Indy.

items.title: Lamar Jackson Leads Ravens to 41-23 Win Over Colts in Week 1
items.one_line: Jackson went 17-of-25 for 324 yards and a TD plus a rushing score; Derrick Henry added 144 yards and three TDs in Jesse Minter's debut.

items.title: Bills Host Lions in Highmark Stadium Debut Thursday Night Clash
items.one_line: Both teams enter 1-0; Buffalo is favored by 4.5 with a 53.5 total as Josh Allen faces a short-week Lions club missing safeties Kerby Joseph and Brian Branch.

items.title: Josh Allen's Four TDs Lead Bills to 36-31 Thriller Over Texans
items.one_line: Allen threw for 334 yards and two scores while rushing for two more, powering Buffalo to a road win in Joe Brady's debut.

items.title: Panthers Waive Rookie WR Jimmy Horn Jr. After Punt Fumble
items.one_line: Carolina waived sixth-rounder Jimmy Horn Jr. after he muffed a punt in the 59-37 loss to Chicago, and promoted LB Tyrel Dodson from the practice squad.

items.title: Bears Coach Ben Johnson's Bold Fourth-Down Call Draws Backlash in 59-37 Win
items.one_line: Johnson's early fourth-and-one sneak failed, but Chicago bounced back with 552 yards and eight TDs in the highest-scoring NFL season opener ever.

items.title: Bears Crush Panthers 59-37 in Record Week 1 Scorigami
items.one_line: Caleb Williams threw for 269 yards and two TDs while rushing for two more; D'Andre Swift ran for 124 yards and three scores.

items.title: Bengals Offensive Line Shines in 33-27 Win Over Bucs
items.one_line: Cincinnati allowed pressure on just 21.6% of dropbacks—the NFL's lowest entering MNF—with rookie RT Amarius Mims shutting down Rueben Bain Jr.

items.title: Browns Place Rookie RB Dylan Sampson on IR After Knee Injury
items.one_line: Cleveland put 2025 fourth-rounder Dylan Sampson on IR and signed Jaleel McLaughlin from the practice squad ahead of Week 2 at Tampa Bay.

items.title: Browns Routed 34-10 by Jaguars in 2026 Opener, Watson Draws Scrutiny
items.one_line: Trevor Lawrence threw four TDs; Deshaun Watson took five sacks but coach Todd Monken is sticking with him for Week 2.

items.title: Giants Stun Cowboys 28-20 in 2026 Opener, Igniting NFC East Rivalry
items.one_line: Jaxson Dart's three TD passes and Dak Prescott's late-second-quarter INT flipped the game; Jerry Jones called the pick the turning point.

items.title: CeeDee Lamb's Shrug After Cowboys' Giants Loss Goes Memorable
items.one_line: Told Dallas had just two second-half drives, Lamb shrugged 'That's crazy. Good to know' after five catches for 44 yards and a score.

items.title: Cowboys Sign Tyler Goodson from Falcons Practice Squad
items.one_line: Dallas added the former Iowa back after placing Malik Davis on IR with a season-ending hip injury, bolstering depth behind Javonte Williams.

items.title: Colin Cowherd Dumps on Bo Nix After Broncos' Chiefs Rout
items.one_line: In the 31-10 loss Nix went 17-of-28 for 131 yards with a TD, INT, four sacks and three fumbles; Cowherd said Nix is still in the 'Do we make him the future?' phase.

items.title: Broncos Face NFL's Toughest Early Schedule After Week 1 Rout
items.one_line: After the 10-31 loss at KC, Denver hosts Jacksonville then faces Rams, 49ers, Chargers and Seahawks—Sharp's No. 1 toughest stretch through Week 6.

items.title: Lions Face Offensive Line Injuries Before Bills Clash
items.one_line: LG Christian Mahogany (hip) and rookie RT Blake Miller (knee) missed practice; C Juice Scruggs is limited, and safeties Kerby Joseph and Brian Branch are out for TNF.

items.title: Dan Campbell Downplays Big Lions Roster Moves Despite New Cap Space
items.one_line: Restructures for St. Brown and Sewell created ~$38–39M in cap space; Campbell said he doesn't expect a major roster upgrade before the deadline.

items.title: Lions Rookie Skyler Gill-Howard Shines in NFL Debut vs. Saints
items.one_line: The sixth-round Texas Tech product played 47 snaps in the 31-30 OT win, drawing praise for dominating Saints guard Cesar Ruiz.

items.title: Packers to Rotate Linemen After Rough Vikings Loss
items.one_line: OC Adam Stenavich plans to rotate OL after Love took 18 hits in the 39-22 loss, giving Anthony Belton more reps with Zach Tom settled at RT.

items.title: Packers Host Tryouts for Six Players After Week 1 Loss
items.one_line: Green Bay worked out DTs Harris and Hunt, WRs Nash/Oliver/Skinner, and DE Cruz Smith; also added Eric Johnson to the practice squad.

items.title: Packers Fans Blast LaFleur After Vikings Collapse
items.one_line: A failed fourth-and-1 early in the fourth sparked Minnesota's 29-point run; fans vented over late-game decisions amid a six-game losing streak.

items.title: Josh Allen's Four TDs Lead Bills to 36-31 Thriller Over Texans
items.one_line: Allen's late 34-yard TD to Joshua Palmer gave Buffalo its first win in Houston since 2006; C.J. Stroud's late fumble sealed it.

items.title: Colts Routed by Ravens in 2026 Opener, Fueling Steichen and QB Debates
items.one_line: Baltimore piled up 506 yards; Daniel Jones went 19-of-31 for 166 yards with a TD and INT as Steichen called the effort unacceptable.

items.title: Colts Defense Reviews Green Dot After Week 1 Communication Woes
items.one_line: Coordinator Lou Anarumo is evaluating Cam Bynum's green-dot role after alignment and tempo miscues in the 41-23 loss.

items.title: Colts Fans Erupt After 41-23 Home Opener Loss to Ravens
items.one_line: A postgame Twitter Space boiled over at Jones, GM Ballard, and Steichen, with anger tied to the Sauce Gardner trade and a 309-day win drought.

items.title: Jaguars Sign Edge Rusher BJ Ojulari After Cardinals Waiver
items.one_line: Jacksonville is signing former Cardinals second-rounder BJ Ojulari for pass-rush depth amid questions about injured DE BJ Green's elbow.

items.title: Jaguars Crush Browns 34-10 as Lawrence Shines, Watson Struggles
items.one_line: Lawrence went 18-of-23 for 245 yards and four TDs as Jacksonville jumped to a 24-0 halftime lead.

items.title: Nick Wright Crowns Trevor Lawrence Top of Mahomes Mountain
items.one_line: Wright placed Lawrence at the peak of his QB pyramid after a 9-0 stretch with 28 TDs and a 111.5 rating, including four TDs in Week 1.

items.title: Kenneth Walker III Torches Broncos Defense in Chiefs Debut
items.one_line: Walker rushed for 173 yards and a TD on 23 carries, forcing 14 missed tackles in a 31-10 win; Andy Reid called it spectacular.

items.title: Undrafted Rookie Kahlil Benson Shines Protecting Mahomes in Chiefs Win
items.one_line: The Indiana product allowed just one pressure on 32 pass snaps—best among Week 1 rookies—starting at LT after the first-rounder got hurt.

items.title: L'Jarius Sneed Shines in Chiefs Return Against Broncos
items.one_line: Back on a one-year deal after Titans injuries, Sneed locked down the slot with physical play in the Monday night rout.

items.title: Raiders' Brock Bowers Day-to-Day After Knee Surgery, Eyes Week 2 Return
items.one_line: Bowers had a meniscus trim and is day-to-day with hope he plays vs. the Chargers; Michael Mayer had six catches in Week 1.

items.title: Raiders Dominate Dolphins 27-13 in Season-Opening Win Under Kubiak
items.one_line: Ashton Jeanty ran for 102 yards and two receiving TDs; Kirk Cousins threw three TDs in Klint Kubiak's first win.

items.title: Chargers Sign Gary Jennings to Roster After Lambert-Smith Injury
items.one_line: LAC placed KeAndre Lambert-Smith on IR (hamstring), promoted Jennings, and listed Ladd McConkey day-to-day with a rib injury ahead of the Raiders.

items.title: Chargers Fall 26-14 to Cardinals in 2026 Opener at SoFi
items.one_line: Arizona controlled with 393 yards; Herbert was intercepted and McConkey left early with ribs as Harbaugh cited sloppy execution.

items.title: Justin Herbert Sacked 241 Times in 99 Games Sparks Charger Line Debate
items.one_line: The OL's ongoing struggles—worse after three more sacks in the Cardinals loss—are fueling frustration under new OC Mike McDaniel.

items.title: Aaron Donald Targets Rams Debut Against Giants in Week 2
items.one_line: Ian Rapoport says a very realistic chance Donald plays Monday Night vs. NYG after sitting out the Australia loss while building conditioning.

items.title: Rams' Myles Garrett Out at Least Four Games After Knee Surgery
items.one_line: Garrett is on IR after arthroscopic knee surgery; eligible to return Week 6 vs. Arizona after missing snaps in the 27-7 loss to SF.

items.title: Dolphins Rookie Kyle Louis Out Few Weeks with MCL Sprain
items.one_line: The fourth-round pick suffered an MCL sprain after three defensive snaps in the Raiders loss; Hafley says he'll miss at least Week 2 at SF.

items.title: Malik Willis Draws Mixed Reviews in Dolphins Debut Loss
items.one_line: Willis went 15-of-27 for 220 yards with an INT and five sacks plus a rushing TD; analysts noted big-time throws despite poor protection.

items.title: Dolphins Rookie Kadyn Proctor Shines in NFL Debut
items.one_line: The 12th-overall left guard played 55 snaps, allowed just two pressures with no sacks, and led Miami in run-blocking grade.

items.title: Vikings Fans Split on QB Choice After Comeback Win Over Packers
items.one_line: Kyler Murray left after 11 plays with a concussion; Carson Wentz threw three TDs in the 39-22 rally as fans debate J.J. McCarthy.

items.title: Vikings Blitz Packers in Record 82% Rate for 39-22 Comeback Win
items.one_line: Brian Flores' defense blitzed on 82.1% of dropbacks—the highest in modern history—sparking 29 unanswered points.

items.title: Week 1 NFL Run Efficiency by Gap Reveals Patriots' Struggles
items.one_line: New England posted negative efficiency in every rushing gap in the 10-13 loss to Seattle, per Ray Carpenter's EPA charts.

items.title: Tyler Shough Tops NFL Passing Yards in Saints' Epic Comeback Loss
items.one_line: Shough completed 35 of 56 for 410 yards, three TDs and two picks in a 31-30 OT loss to Detroit; Chris Olave had 10 for 182.

items.title: Saints Rally from 21 Down but Lose 31-30 to Lions in OT Controversy
items.one_line: A reversed fumble-return TD and a failed late two-point try crushed New Orleans after Shough's second-half explosion.

items.title: Giants Stun Cowboys 28-20 in 2026 Opener, Igniting NFC East Rivalry
items.one_line: Jaxson Dart threw three TDs in his first start under John Harbaugh; New York's first Week 1 home win since 2010.

items.title: Isaiah Likely Shines in Giants Debut with Two TDs vs. Cowboys
items.one_line: Likely caught all eight targets for 78 yards and two scores, converting four third downs after following Harbaugh from Baltimore.

items.title: Giants Top Cowboys 28-20 in Season Opener at MetLife
items.one_line: Dart threw three scores, Cam Skattebo rushed one in after injury return, and NYG converted 9 of 11 third downs.

items.title: Jets Bolster Roster with Veterans Amid Early Injuries to Cooper and Fitzpatrick
items.one_line: Omar Cooper Jr. is week-to-week (ankle); Minkah Fitzpatrick out 2–3 weeks (groin). Jets signed Sterling Shepard to the PS and promoted CB Jordan Clark.

items.title: Jets Call for White Out at Home Opener vs. Packers
items.one_line: New York is urging fans to wear white for Sunday's MetLife home opener with new all-white alternates after a 1-0 start.

items.title: Eagles Place Landon Dickerson on Injured Reserve After Rough Opener
items.one_line: Three-time Pro Bowl guard Dickerson is out at least four games with a right-knee bone bruise; Drew Kendall steps up at LG.

items.title: Riq Woolen Shuts Down Receivers in Eagles Debut Win
items.one_line: Signed from Seattle, Woolen played all 70 snaps and allowed zero catches on four targets in the 24-22 win over Washington.

items.title: Steelers' Joey Porter Jr. Draws Trade Interest Amid Contract Standoff
items.one_line: Porter missed Week 1 with a back injury as talks stalled; Lions and Chiefs among clubs interested per Rapoport.

items.title: T.J. Watt's Dominant Return Powers Steelers Past Falcons
items.one_line: Watt earned a 92.3 PFF grade with two sacks, three TFLs, and a 35-yard pick-six in the 20-13 win.

items.title: Seahawks' Darnold Faces Four Weeks Out with Glute Injury
items.one_line: Sam Darnold's soft-tissue glute injury could sideline him ~four weeks; Drew Lock (16-of-22, 187, TD) starts the next one or two.

items.title: Seahawks Top Bucky Brooks' Week 1 NFL Rankings
items.one_line: FOX's Bucky Brooks put defending-champ Seattle No. 1 after the 13-10 defensive win over New England.

items.title: 49ers Bolster Lines with Jackson, Willis, and Stoll After Injuries
items.one_line: SF signed DT McKinnley Jackson to the PS, promoted TE Brayden Willis, and added TE Jack Stoll after Alfred Collins (IR) and Jake Tonges' knee injury.

items.title: Brock Purdy Tops NFL QB Efficiency Stats After Strong 49ers Opener
items.one_line: Purdy went 25-of-34 for 205 yards and three TDs in the 27-7 Australia win over the Rams; since 2023 he leads EPA/dropback.

items.title: Titans Stumble in Opener as Cam Ward Faces Early Scrutiny
items.one_line: No. 1 pick Cam Ward went 19-of-32 for 140 yards and a TD in a 23-10 loss to the Jets; Saleh called him at the 'floor' but urged patience.

items.title: Titans Beat Writer Nick Suss Announces Departure After Four Happy Years
items.one_line: The Tennessean's Titans beat writer since 2022 said Monday was his last day; Tyler Palmateer covers interim.

items.title: Tyler Owens Delivers Crushing Punt Tackle in Commanders-Eagles Clash
items.one_line: The third-year safety bulldozed blockers to smash Britain Covey; Dan Quinn, J.J. Watt, and Schefter hailed it as elite special-teams play.

items.title: Rookie Sonny Styles Powers Through Barkley for Debut Sack on Hurts
items.one_line: The seventh-overall pick had four tackles, two TFLs, and a sack in the 24-22 loss after stepping up for an injured teammate.
